SELECT
YEAR(so.create_at) as period
DATE_FORMAT(so.create_at, '%Y-%m') as period
DATE(so.create_at) as period
, SUM(si.quantity) as totalQuantity, SUM(si.subtotal) as totalAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT so.id) as orderCount FROM e_wms_sales_item si INNER JOIN e_wms_sales_order so ON si.order_id = so.id WHERE si.is_delete = 0 AND so.status = 1 AND so.is_delete = 0
AND so.create_at >= #{startDate}
AND so.create_at <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
AND so.customer_id = #{customerId}
GROUP BY
YEAR(so.create_at)
DATE_FORMAT(so.create_at, '%Y-%m')
DATE(so.create_at)
ORDER BY period DESC

SELECT
so.customer_id as rowId, c.customer_name as rowName, c.customer_phone as rowPhone,
p.brand_id as rowId, b.brand_name as rowName, '' as rowPhone,
p.id as rowId, p.product_name as rowName, '' as rowPhone,
YEAR(so.create_at) as period,
DATE(so.create_at) as period,
DATE_FORMAT(so.create_at, '%Y-%m') as period,
SUM(si.subtotal) as amount, SUM(si.quantity) as quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT so.id) as orderCount FROM e_wms_sales_item si INNER JOIN e_wms_sales_order so ON si.order_id = so.id LEFT JOIN e_wms_sku sku ON si.sku_id = sku.id LEFT JOIN e_wms_product p ON sku.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN e_wms_customer c ON so.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN e_wms_brand b ON p.brand_id = b.id
WHERE si.is_delete = 0 AND so.status = 1 AND so.is_delete = 0
AND so.create_at >= #{startDate}
AND so.create_at <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
AND so.customer_id = #{customerId}
GROUP BY
so.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_phone
p.brand_id, b.brand_name
p.id, p.product_name
, period ORDER BY rowId, period

SELECT si.id, si.order_id as orderId, si.sku_id as skuId, si.quantity, si.sale_price as salePrice, si.subtotal, si.batch_id as batchId, si.create_at as createAt, si.update_at as updateAt, si.is_delete as isDelete, sku.sku_code as skuCode, sku.sku_name as skuName FROM e_wms_sales_item si LEFT JOIN e_wms_sku sku ON si.sku_id = sku.id WHERE si.order_id = #{orderId} AND si.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY si.id ASC
